description: An alternative to the sidebar. Primarily used for mobile applications.

props.height: Sets the height for the component. A percentage value is relative to the layout and ignores `density`.
props.grow: Force all [v-btn](/components/buttons) children to take up all available horizontal space.
props.mode: Changes the orientation and active state styling of the component.
props.zIndex: Overrides the [z-index](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/z-index) that is automatically calculated by the layout system, useful for layering it above or below other overlay components.

events.update:active: Event that is emitted when the active state changes.
